avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 metabolism, decreasing amiodarone levels and reducing antiarrhythmic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort; do not use concurrently with amiodarone

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Inhibits CYP3A4, increasing amiodarone concentrations and risk of toxicity including QT prolongation and torsades de pointes
avoid_supplements.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; counsel patient on hidden sources

avoid_supplements.name: QT-Prolonging Supplements (Hawthorn, Licorice)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive QT prolongation with amiodarone increases risk of life-threatening arrhythmias and torsades de pointes
avoid_supplements.action: Strictly contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid all herbal products without pharmacist review

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin E (high doses >400 IU/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive anticoagulant effects; amiodarone increases warfarin levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor INR more frequently if patient takes high-dose vitamin E; limit to ≤400 IU daily

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce amiodarone efficacy through CYP3A4 interactions; antioxidant effects may compete with drug action
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor arrhythmia control and consider dose adjustments

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and citrus juices (Seville oranges, pomelo)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Inhibits CYP3A4, significantly elevating amiodarone plasma concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; avoid all grapefruit juice and related citrus products

caution_foods.name: Cranberry juice (large quantities)
caution_foods.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4 inhibition; limited clinical significance but possible minor interaction
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; no absolute contraindication but excessive consumption should be avoided

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium may increase fluid retention and worsen heart failure risk in susceptible patients on amiodarone
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderate sodium restriction as part of standard cardiac dietary management

monitoring_notes: Amiodarone has extensive hepatic metabolism via multiple CYP enzymes and substantial drug-drug interaction potential; monitor QTc interval, serum amiodarone levels (therapeutic 0.5-2.5 mcg/mL), and thyroid/liver function regularly. All supplements require pharmacist review before use due to arrhythmia risk and narrow therapeutic window.
